title: Consultation and Session Notes
sub: The BCBA’s record of each school visit, consultation, training, session, meeting or call: when and where, who was there, which plan was in force, what the data and the integrity check showed, what was found, what was recommended, what was changed and on whose authority, what was taught and left behind, and what happens next. A log of every note with search and filters, a running total of hours by month and type, and a printable single note.
